_help: Settings for the Etsy sync (scripts/etsy-sync.mjs), which adds new Etsy listings, updates existing ones and marks ones gone from Etsy as sold out. skipTitles: listings whose title starts with any of these are never added. ignoreListingIds: Etsy listing ids to never add. sectionCategories: which shop section a new listing goes in, matched against its Etsy section name. maxNewPerRun and maxSoldOutPerRun: safety stops. newBadgeDays: how long a new item shows the 'New' badge.
